general.descriptionTextModule: Fill any number of footer areas with text and images via drag and drop.

builder.confirmDelete: Really delete the layout "%name%"? This cannot be undone.
builder.confirmDiscard: There are unsaved changes. Switch anyway?
builder.saveSuccess: Layout and arrangement have been saved and the shop cache cleared.
builder.saveSuccessNoCache: Layout and arrangement have been saved. The cache could not be cleared, please clear it manually.
builder.saveError: The layout could not be saved:
builder.deleteError: The layout could not be deleted:
builder.altHelp: Leave empty to use the alternative text from the media library. Can be set per language.
builder.imageRequired: Please upload an image or choose one from the media library.
builder.areaRemoveConfirm: Remove this area with all its elements?
builder.gridHint: As on desktop: %columns% columns. Add elements with "+ Text" and "+ Image", drag areas by their title to rearrange them and choose the width at the bottom.

settings.title: DMX4ALL Footer Editor – Info
settings.editorText: All settings – layouts, areas, arrangement, columns and design – are made directly in the Footer Editor under Content › DMX4ALL Footer Editor.

doc.title: Plugin information
doc.error: The document could not be loaded.
doc.errorHint: Usually fixed by deactivating and reactivating the plugin, then a hard reload. With shell access: bin/console assets:install.

support.title: Manufacturer and support
support.text: Questions, bugs or wishes about this plugin? Just get in touch.

help.title: Help and support
help.text: These details help when you get in touch with support.
help.copySuccess: The details are on your clipboard.
help.copyError: The details could not be copied.
help.mailIntro: Please describe your question or the problem here.

arrangement.title: Arrangement in the footer
arrangement.text: Defines where the areas appear and how many columns fit side by side. Applies per sales channel, not per language.
arrangement.inherited: Values from "All" are inherited. Changes apply to this sales channel only.
arrangement.ownValues: This sales channel has its own values.
arrangement.hideEmptyHint: Next to default columns, empty areas are always skipped.

translation.hint: Empty languages show the text of the default language in the shop.

core.text: Content comes from Shopware. Use "Content" above to add your own texts and images or show them instead.
core.hint: The Shopware parts – service hotline, footer navigation columns and everything you move into the column row – appear grey in the grid and can be moved, widened, styled or hidden like your own areas.
core.arrangementHint: All parts, including hotline, navigation, logos and bottom bar, are positioned freely in the grid below.
core.outsideText: In Shopware these parts sit below the columns. Move them into the column row to position, widen and style them like all others.
core.mode_append_hint: Your elements appear below the Shopware content.
core.mode_replace_hint: Only your elements appear, the Shopware content is dropped.
core.headlineHelp: Leave empty to keep the Shopware headline. Can be set per language.
core.replaceFallback: No own elements yet – until then the shop shows the Shopware content here.

autosave.label: Auto-save
autosave.help: Saves changes automatically after the chosen delay. This browser remembers the setting.

size.title: Size
size.help: Empty = automatic. Give only width or only height to keep the aspect ratio. With both, the image is fitted into the box, not distorted. It never gets wider than the column.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.text: Create as many layouts as you like, e.g. for campaigns or seasons. The shop uses the active layout per sales channel and language; the most specific one wins.
layouts.name: Name
layouts.statusNew: New layout – created with the next save.
layouts.statusInactiveNone: Inactive. The shop shows the default footer here.
layouts.scopeHint: Multiple selection possible. "All" = no restriction. A layout for specific sales channels or languages takes precedence over one for all.
layouts.multiChannelConfig: Several sales channels selected: the defaults for all sales channels are edited here.
layouts.deactivated: "%name%" was deactivated because it covers the same scope.
layouts.deletedHint: Contains deleted sales channels or languages
layouts.deletedSome: This layout contains deleted sales channels or languages. It still applies to the others.
layouts.deletedNowhere: This layout is only assigned to deleted sales channels or languages and is not shown anywhere in the shop.
layouts.statusNowhere: Active but without effect: no existing sales channel or language assigned.

transfer.invalidFile: The file is not a valid Footer Editor export.
transfer.importFound: Found in "%file%": %count% layout(s). Choose what to import.
transfer.applyConfig: Take over the arrangement from the file (position, columns, defaults for all sales channels)
transfer.importHint: Imported layouts are created as new, inactive layouts. Unknown sales channels or languages become "All". Missing images are recreated from their address.
transfer.importDone: %count% layout(s) imported. They stay inactive until you activate them.
transfer.mediaMissing: %count% image(s) could not be taken over. The affected image elements are empty.
transfer.exportEveryHint: %count% layouts in one file, e.g. as a backup

design.title: Design
design.sampleText: This is how normal text looks in this area.
design.hint: Empty fields keep the theme look. Colours as #rrggbb, rgba(…) or transparent.

acl.readonly: You only have read permissions for the Footer Editor. You can view and export, but not make changes.
